counterparties.title: Counterparties
counterparties.description: Buyers, suppliers, banks and government bodies.
counterparties.emptyBody: Add a buyer or supplier so you can link expenses and sales to them.
counterparties.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be removed from the list.

journal.title: Transactions
journal.description: Every receipt and payment, with its date, amount, account and cost center.
journal.addHint: Date, account and cost center are remembered for the next entry.
journal.cashNetHint: Money into the cash desk and bank less money out: loans and the owner's money count, entries on credit and depreciation do not. The farm's net result is in the Monthly result report.
journal.totalsHint: Approved transactions only. Animals, machinery and stock bought, entries on credit and depreciation are included.
journal.emptyBody: Enter the first expense or income, or change the filters.
journal.deleteBody: The unapproved entry will be removed. The change stays in the audit history.
journal.fxHint: Leave empty to use the nearest rate from the rates table.

treatmentHint.expense: Charged to the chosen cost center straight away.
treatmentHint.inventory: Goes into stock. It reaches cost only when issued, so it is never counted twice.
treatmentHint.capex: A fixed asset. It reaches cost gradually, through depreciation.
treatmentHint.animal: Added to the animal's own value, not to herd expenses.

capitalHint.contribution: The owner's own money coming into the farm. It is neither income nor profit.
capitalHint.withdrawal: Money the owner takes back from the farm. It is not an expense.

approval.emptyBody: Any transaction at or above the approval threshold lands here.
approval.ownEntry: You entered this one, so someone else has to approve it.
approval.ownVoid: You entered this one, so someone else has to void it.

accounts.title: Cash and bank
accounts.description: Cash, bank accounts and daily balances.
accounts.statementHint: Money in and out per day, and the closing balance.
accounts.closeBody: "{{name}}" will leave the list. Its history is kept.
accounts.emptyBody: Add a cash desk or a bank account to start tracking money.

fields.name: Name
fields.openingHint: Transactions before this date count as already in the balance.

fx.description: Foreign-currency transactions convert to so'm at these rates.
fx.addHint: One rate per day. Saving a day again corrects it.
fx.emptyBody: Add a USD, EUR or RUB rate for imported purchases.

debts.title: Debts
debts.description: Who owes us, whom we owe, and when it is due.
debts.payrollHint: Wages are paid from the payroll run under Staff, which knows each person's share.
debts.amountInAccountCurrency: Enter the amount in the account's currency ({{currency}}). It is converted at the stored rate.
debts.pendingSettlement: A payment of {{amount}} is waiting for approval.
debts.emptyBody: Purchases and sales on credit appear here.

unpaidReceipts.hint: Goods came from a supplier, but no payment or debt is recorded for them yet.
unpaidReceipts.paidRequest: A paid purchase request is still waiting for these goods, so money cannot be recorded here: it would count twice. If this is that delivery, cancel the receipt and receive the goods through the request. If it is another delivery, receive the request first.
unpaidReceipts.categoryHint: Some goods here have no category of their own. This one is used for the whole receipt.
unpaidReceipts.empty: Every receipt has its money recorded
unpaidReceipts.emptyBody: A purchase received with no payment or debt appears here.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Plan, actual and variance by category and month.
budget.noCenterPlan: No plan was entered for "{{name}}": the plan is kept for the farm as a whole. Only the actuals show here.
budget.toDateNote: Difference and execution are measured against the plan of the months that have begun: months still to come are neither a saving nor a shortfall.
budget.addCategory: Add a category to the plan
budget.chartHint: Stock purchases count in the month they were bought: a budget controls spending.
budget.emptyBody: Enter the plan by month and the variance against actuals shows right away.

costs.title: Cost and profitability
costs.description: What each herd, field and cost center really costs.
costs.head: Head
costs.breakdownTitle: What the cost is made of
costs.noHerdsBody: Once a herd exists, its cost is worked out here.
costs.noFieldsBody: Assign a crop to a field and its cost appears here.
costs.centerChartHint: Fields and herds, after machinery and overhead are shared out.
costs.noDataBody: Figures appear once expenses are entered or stock is issued.
costs.internalNote: Own produce, such as alfalfa, moves to the herd at an internal price, so the sum of centers can exceed what the farm really paid. The farm's net result (income less the cost of what was used) is in the Monthly result report.

cashflow.title: Cash flow
cashflow.description: Expected money in, money out and balance by month.
cashflow.gapBody: Months short of cash: {{n}}. Deepest gap: {{amount}}. Plan ahead: delay spending, bring sales forward, or arrange short-term financing.
cashflow.methodNote: This is a statistical forecast, not a promise. It rests on the budget, {{months}} months of history, the loan schedule and debt due dates.
cashflow.beyondPlan: The budget runs to {{month}}. Later months show only loan and debt payments, so they are not a forecast.
cashflow.lowConfidenceBody: There is no budget and under three months of history, so this forecast only reflects loans and debt due dates. Enter a budget.
cashflow.balanceChartHint: Any month below zero is a month short of cash.
cashflow.flowChart: Money in and out by month
cashflow.detailHint: What this month's figures are made of.
cashflow.actualHint: Transfers between own accounts and credit transactions are left out.
cashflow.emptyBody: Approved transactions appear here by month.

loans.title: Loans
loans.description: Loans, payment schedules, interest and what is still owed.
loans.addHint: The payment schedule is built from the terms automatically.
loans.payHint: Principal {{principal}} and interest {{interest}}. Interest is recorded as an expense.
loans.overdueBody: Pay it soon to avoid a late-payment penalty.
loans.emptyBody: Once added, loan payments feed the calendar and the cash-flow forecast.
loans.deleteBody: "{{name}}" and its schedule will be deleted.

fields.name: Name
fields.disburseHint: If chosen, the loan money is recorded into this account.

accepted.title: {{holder}} received {{amount}}
accepted.pending: It is at or above the approval limit, so it waits for approval before it counts.

actions.accepted: Done: the cash is in your account now
actions.acceptedPending: Recorded. It counts once it is approved
actions.disputed: The sender has been told why

cashHolders.title: Cash holders
cashHolders.description: Cash handed to people for farm spending: what each received, spent and should still hold.
cashHolders.emptyTitle: No one holds farm cash yet
cashHolders.emptyBody: Hand cash to the farm manager or anyone who buys for the farm. It counts once they confirm it reached them.
cashHolders.personsCash: A person's cash for farm spending

stats.investedHint: The owner's own money put in, less what was taken back
stats.waitingHint: Cash handed over, waiting for the person to press “Received”

form.title: Hand over cash
form.description: Nothing moves until the person confirms the cash reached them.

detail.description: What came in and went out over the period, and what should be in hand now.
detail.closeBody: Nothing is left in hand. The entries stay in the journal.

toast.sent: Sent. It counts once they confirm

scenarios.title: Scenario planner
scenarios.description: Three years ahead, month by month: the flock, the profit, the cash, and the price per kg at which the farm breaks even. Change an assumption and the plan is worked out again.
scenarios.saveHint: The plan is saved with the assumptions now on the page.
scenarios.noStallMonths: No month is marked: the flock grazes all year.

gaps.title: Empty assumptions the app has a starting value for: {{n}}
gaps.body: The farm's records give no figure for them, so the results that rest on them show a dash. The starting values are the app's own, not the farm's: check each one after filling.
gaps.fill: Fill the empty fields with starting values

invalid.title: The plan cannot be worked out yet
invalid.body: These figures are outside what a plan accepts: {{fields}}. Correct them to see the result.

missing.title: Some figures cannot be worked out
missing.body: They show a dash because these assumptions are empty: {{fields}}.

fields.lambsPerEweLambing: Lambs born per ewe that lambs
fields.pricePerKg: Price per kg of live weight
fields.feedAdultStallPerMonth: Feed for a grown sheep, a stall month
fields.feedAdultGrazingPerMonth: Feed for a grown sheep, a grazing month
fields.feedLambPerMonth: Feed for a growing lamb, a month
fields.otherCostPerHeadPerMonth: Other cost per head, a month

help.openingReplacements: Ewe lambs kept to join the ewes, not yet lambed.
help.openingLambs: Lambs and fattening stock that will be sold.
help.lambingShare: Of all ewes in the flock in the lambing month.
help.replacementShare: Of the ewe lambs weaned. The rest are sold, with all ram lambs.
help.firstLambingAgeMonths: A kept ewe lamb joins the ewes at this age.
help.eweDeathsPerYear: Share of the ewes, spread evenly over the year.
help.eweCullsPerYear: Share of the ewes, spread evenly over the year. A culled ewe is sold.
help.cullEwePrice: Per head. A cull ewe is not priced by weight here.
help.feedAdultGrazingPerMonth: Ewes, rams and kept ewe lambs past the sale age, in a month not marked as stall feed.
help.feedLambPerMonth: A lamb held for sale, or a kept ewe lamb younger than the sale age.
help.otherCostPerHeadPerMonth: Charged on every head, such as veterinary care.
help.fixedCostPerMonth: Spent whatever the size of the flock: wages, fuel, repairs, field work.
help.openingCash: Money on hand in the first month. It can be below zero.
help.stallMonths: In these months a grown sheep costs the stall figure, in the others the grazing figure.

origin.suggested: No figure in the farm's records. The app's starting value: {{value}}
origin.none: No figure in the farm's records

sources.sales: approved sales of the last 12 months
sources.rations: bought feed in today's rations; the cost of growing the farm's own feed is in the fixed cost

oneOffs.title: One-off outlays
oneOffs.help: A purchase or a building paid once, in the month it falls. What was invested before the plan can be entered in the first month.

stats.priceShort: The assumed price, {{price}}, does not cover it
stats.paybackHint: The first month in which everything earned since the start exceeds everything spent, one-off outlays included.

cash.shortBody: The lowest point is {{amount}}, in {{month}}. That much has to be found beforehand, or spending moved.
cash.okTitle: Cash stays above zero for all three years

years.title: Year by year
years.hint: Money in {{currency}}. Head counts are at the end of each year. A year is twelve months from the plan's first month.

charts.cashHint: The shaded months are below zero.
charts.herdHint: Head at month end, after lambing, sales and culling.
charts.empty: Not enough assumptions to draw this.

method.title: How this is worked out
method.breakEvenWith: Break-even price: all costs of the three years, {{costs}}, divided by the {{kg}} kg of lamb live weight sold. Income from cull ewes is not taken off.
method.breakEven: Break-even price: all costs of the three years divided by the kilograms of lamb live weight sold. Income from cull ewes is not taken off.
method.months: Each month, in order: kept ewe lambs old enough join the ewes, a twelfth of the year's deaths and culls leave, the ewes lamb in the lambing month, and lambs that reach the sale age are sold. Costs are charged on the flock as it stands after that.
method.leftOut: Left out: the number of rams stays as it starts, no lamb is lost after weaning, wool brings nothing, and a cull ewe sells by the head.
method.notPromise: This is arithmetic on the assumptions above, not a forecast of the market.

compare.title: Plans side by side
compare.hint: What each plan leads to, then the assumptions in which they differ.
compare.noDifferences: These plans rest on the same assumptions.

saved.title: Saved plans
saved.hint: Open a plan on the page, or tick up to {{n}} to see them side by side.
saved.emptyBody: Set the assumptions, then save them under a name to come back to or to compare.
saved.emptyBodyReadOnly: Plans saved by the farm's finance staff show here.
saved.limit: {{n}} plans are ticked. Untick one to add another.
saved.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Other plans stay.
saved.name: Name

errors.WAGES_PAID_FROM_PAYROLL: Wages are paid from the payroll run under Staff, not from here.
errors.TRANSACTION_CHANGED: This entry was changed after you opened it. It now reads {{amount}} {{currency}}. Nothing was saved: read it again, then decide.
errors.ACCOUNT_CLOSED: This account is closed. Choose another one.
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: This account holds a different currency.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_EMPTY: This account still holds {{balance}}. Move the money out first.
errors.ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Choose a cash or bank account.
errors.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_DEBT: That is more than the debt. Up to {{outstanding}} can be settled.
errors.CATEGORY_KIND_MISMATCH: This category does not fit the transaction type.
errors.COST_CENTER_CLOSED: This cost center is closed. Choose another one.
errors.DEBT_ALREADY_SETTLED: A payment already covers this debt. Cancel the payment first.
errors.FX_RATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: This rate is too far from the stored rate of {{stored}}. Check it, or correct the stored rate.
errors.FX_RATE_REQUIRED: There is no exchange rate for this date. Enter one.
errors.INVALID_AMOUNT: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.INVALID_PAYMENT_METHOD: This payment method does not fit the transaction.
errors.LOAN_HAS_PAYMENTS: A loan with payments or received money cannot be deleted.
errors.NOT_APPROVED: Only an approved transaction can be voided.
errors.NOT_PENDING: This transaction is not waiting for approval.
errors.RECEIPT_HAS_MONEY: Money is already recorded for this receipt.
errors.RECEIPT_PAID_BY_REQUEST: A paid purchase request is waiting for these goods, so the money was not recorded: it would count twice. If this is that delivery, cancel receipt {{docNo}} and receive the goods through the request. If it is another delivery, receive the request first.
errors.SAME_MAKER_CHECKER: The person who entered a transaction cannot approve it.
errors.SETTLEMENT_NOT_EDITABLE: A debt payment cannot be edited. Delete it and enter it again.
errors.TRANSACTION_APPROVED: An approved transaction cannot be changed. Void it instead.
errors.TRANSACTION_HAS_SOURCE: This entry came from another module. Change it there.
errors.TRANSACTION_REJECTED: A rejected or voided transaction stays in the journal. Enter a new one.
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_LOCKED: This account already holds money, so its currency cannot change.
errors.INVALID_CAPITAL_ENTRY: The owner's own money moves through one account, without a category, cost center or counterparty.
errors.APPROVER_NOT_ALLOWED: The person named as approver cannot approve payments on this farm.
errors.HOLDER_CANNOT_APPROVE: Someone holding this cash cannot approve or reverse what moves through it.
errors.CAPITAL_NOT_ALLOWED: Only the owner records the owner's own money.
errors.FROM_ACCOUNT_NOT_EXPECTED: Own money does not come from a farm account. Choose a farm account as the source instead.
errors.FROM_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: Choose the account the cash comes from.
errors.HANDOVER_TO_SELF: You cannot hand cash to yourself. Enter it in the journal as a transfer or an owner contribution.
errors.HOLDER_NEEDS_LOGIN: Link this person to a login first, so they can confirm the cash.
errors.HOLDER_NEEDS_FINANCE: This person cannot record expenses yet. Give their role the right to view and create finance entries first.
errors.HANDOVER_OPEN: Cash handed over is still waiting for this person to confirm it.
errors.HOLDER_HAS_CASH: This person still holds cash. Take it back before closing.
errors.HOLDER_CASH_SPENT: Part of this cash has been spent already. Keep it, and take back what is left instead.
errors.HOLDER_CASH_SHORT: This is more than the cash this person holds.
errors.HANDOVER_DECIDED: This handover has already been answered.
errors.NOT_THE_HOLDER: Only the person who received the cash can answer.
errors.NOT_THE_SENDER: Only the person who handed it over can cancel it.
errors.SENDER_NO_LONGER_ALLOWED: The person who sent this may no longer hand over this money.
errors.HANDOVER_NOT_ACCEPTED: Only cash that arrived can be reversed.
errors.HOLDER_ACCOUNT: This is a person's cash. Close it from Cash holders, which checks that nothing is left with them.
errors.USE_CASH_HANDOVER: This is a person's cash. Hand it over from Cash holders, so they confirm it arrived.
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date is in the future.
errors.SYSTEM_COUNTERPARTY: The payroll counterparty is kept by the system: it cannot be renamed or archived.
